codeExplorer.executablePath.description: Custom path to the 'ce' or 'ce.exe' binary. If empty, searches the workspace and system PATH.

codeExplorer.engineVersion.description: Target engine version or probing pattern (e.g. '1.16.*', '^1.16.0', 'latest', or exact version). If empty, automatically matches the extension's major.minor series with fallback to extension version.

codeExplorer.serverPort.description: Port for CodeExplorer WebSocket server. Set to 0 to use an automatically allocated ephemeral port.

codeExplorer.idleTimeout.description: Idle timeout in seconds before the background ce.exe server terminates when all windows are closed.

enumDescriptions: Use built-in IDE language model (Copilot / Gemini in Antigravity) with zero download
Use local or cloud OpenAI-compatible server (Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, DeepSeek, etc.)
Use locally downloaded Qwen-2.5 GGUF model via llama.cpp
codeExplorer.ai.provider.description: AI provider used for domain discovery and architectural intent distillation.

codeExplorer.ai.model.description: Model identifier or family (e.g. 'copilot-gpt-4o', 'gemini-2.0-flash', 'qwen2.5-coder:7b'). Leave empty to use default.

codeExplorer.ai.endpoint.description: Endpoint URL for OpenAI-compatible provider (e.g. http://localhost:11434/v1 for Ollama, http://localhost:1234/v1 for LM Studio).

codeExplorer.ai.apiKey.description: Optional API Key for custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
